# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** Servant and companion to Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She strongly resembles her older sisters, the previous Bowman girls who lived at Echo Cottage. Her looks suit a preference for dark ringlets and red cheeks, though she is not considered as strikingly attractive as Isolde Pembroke.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)_

## Personality

Belinda is an excellent, willing, and deeply compassionate girl who holds Nell Harcourt in total admiration and attempts to copy her mannerisms. She is agreeable to Miss Rosalind's imaginative pretend games and tolerates her mistress's eccentricities without complaint. Expressing deep loyalty, she grows intensely anxious when Miss Rosalind appears weary, lonely, or sick.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## Traits

- Excellent worker  <sub>[v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>
- Tolerant of imaginative play  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Deeply observant and caring  <sub>[v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- Imitative of Nell  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Domestic service and cooking support  <sub>[v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061)</sub>
- Sounding signal horns and echoing outdoors  <sub>[v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073)</sub>

## Goals

- To eventually master walking, talking, and looking like Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>
- To move to Boston upon turning sixteen, following her older sisters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## History

Following the precedent set by her three elder sisters, Leonora Bowman went to reside at Echo Cottage with Miss Rosalind Penrose to assist with household duties in exchange for garments, board, and room. Because of her strong resemblance to her sisters, Miss Rosalind dubbed her "Belinda the Fourth." Unlike her older sisters, Belinda never openly criticized Miss Rosalind's imaginative pretend games. When Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke accidentally arrived at Echo Cottage while seeking directions, Belinda assisted in serving tea and demonstrated the cottage's famous forest echoes by blowing a small tin horn and laughing loudly for the guests. She developed a profound admiration for Nell, frequently practicing in her bedroom mirror to imitate Nell's posture and movements. During a later summer, Belinda invited Nell to gather early strawberries in Mr. Kimball's pasture, where she confided her grave worries regarding Miss Rosalind's declining health and strange behavior.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual birth name is Leonora, though she is called Belinda the Fourth by Miss Rosalind to avoid confusion with her older sisters.  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest and finest of the Bowman daughters who went to live with Miss Rosalind in exchange for room, board, and garments.  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her older sisters—Belinda the First, Julietta (Belinda the Second), and Evelina (Belinda the Third)—each left for Boston upon reaching sixteen years of age.  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes
